hints.content: Therefore, we can set up equivalent proportions and solve for $y$.

$\dfrac{\red{y}}{\blue{6}} = \dfrac{\red{5}}{\blue{10}}$

 Note: As each corresponding $\dfrac{\red{\text{side}}}{\blue{\text{side}}}$ proportion is equivalent, you could use the other sides (i.e., $\dfrac{\red{y}}{\blue{6}} = \dfrac{\red{3.5}}{\blue{7}}$)

Reduce the proportion on the right hand side.

 $\dfrac{\red{y}}{\blue{6}} = \cancel{\dfrac{\red{5}}{\blue{10}}}{\green{\dfrac{1}{2}}}$

Multiply each side by $6$ and simplify.

 $\cancel{6} \times \dfrac{\red{y}}{\cancel{\blue{6}}} = \green{\dfrac{1}{2}} \times 6$
